user.title: Marketplace Guard Gate
user.description: Before anything the Marketplace installs can load, the gate asks the Marketplace Guard app. What the app would quarantine is not installed: the Marketplace puts back what was there, and the install dialog says why.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The gate is already set up.

data.on_no_answer: When Marketplace Guard does not answer

data_description.on_no_answer: Refuse: nothing is installed while the app is stopped. Allow: the install goes ahead unchecked, as without the gate.
data_description.timeout: A scan takes seconds; large repositories and the dependency check can take longer.
